title: From brain waves to words: a new path to communication without surgery
summary: Meta AI researchers developed Brain2Qwerty, a non-invasive brain-computer interface that decodes neural signals from scalp EEG to reconstruct typed text without requiring brain surgery, achieving 73% character accuracy on a 125-word vocabulary.
problem_solved: Enables communication for people with speech or motor impairments through non-invasive brain-computer interface technology without surgical implants.
why_valuable: It offers a safe, non-surgical alternative to existing BCIs, potentially making brain-computer communication accessible to a broader population while advancing our understanding of neural signal processing.
